Copilot Partner Bootcamp
Lab Setup · 2026

Partner Copilot Enablement

Lab Setup Instructions

Follow this guide to create your temporary Microsoft training account, enter the Partner Bootcamp lab environment, and confirm you are ready to build in Microsoft Copilot Studio. Plan on about ten minutes.

Start setup
Before you start Three things matter most
  • Use a Private or Incognito browser window.
  • Write down the credentials the lab assistant gives you.
  • Write down the new password after you change it.
Goal Ready to build in Copilot Studio

At the end, confirm the assigned username appears in the top-right corner of Microsoft Copilot Studio.

Lab code CAPEPartner-T9Z8

Enter this exactly as shown when the lab assistant asks for your workshop pass code.

Start cleanClaim your accountSave your accessEnter the lab

Start clean

Begin with a clean browser session and reach the lab assistant.

01 Start clean

Open a private browser window

Use a Private or Incognito window so your normal Microsoft account does not interfere with the lab tenant sign-in.

Private / Incognito is important.

02 Start clean

Open the workshop lab assistant

Navigate to the lab assistant URL.

https://aka.ms/MCSWorkshopAgent
03 Start clean

Choose Lab Assistant

Click Lab Assistant and wait for the page to load.

Claim your account

Use the Partner Bootcamp lab code to provision your temporary training account.

04 Claim your account

Enter the Partner Bootcamp lab code

Enter the lab code exactly as shown, then click Submit.

CAPEPartner-T9Z8
05 Claim your account

Get a user account

Click Get a User Account to begin provisioning your temporary training user.

06 Claim your account

Accept the terms

Read the terms and conditions, check the consent box, and click Consent and create account.

07 Claim your account

Submit organization details

Fill in the form with your organization information and click Submit.

08 Claim your account

Wait for provisioning

The lab assistant will show a provisioning message while it creates your account.

Save your access

Protect the credentials and password you will need throughout the enablement.

Your lab credentials

Same saver as the top of the page — fill it in here as you go. Values stay only in this browser on this device and stay in sync with the card above.

Saved locally in your browser.
09 Save your access

Write down your credentials

In a few moments, you will receive your login credentials. Save them somewhere safe so you can return to the lab environment later.

Do not skip this step. You will need these credentials again.

10 Save your access

Open the training environment

Click the training link in the chat or open it directly, then sign in with the credentials you were just given.

https://aka.ms/MCSStartTraining
11 Save your access

Change your password

Enter the password provided by the lab assistant, choose a new password you will remember, and save the new password.

Save the changed password too.

Enter the lab

Enter the training environment and confirm Copilot Studio is using your assigned lab account.

12 Enter the lab

Select the stay-signed-in checkbox

Select the don't show this again box when prompted. It may not change the behavior, but it keeps the flow moving.

13 Enter the lab

Bookmark the welcome page

You are in. When you see the welcome page, bookmark it so you can get back quickly.

14 Enter the lab

Open Microsoft Copilot Studio

Navigate to Microsoft Copilot Studio and confirm you are signed into the assigned lab user shown in the top-right corner.

https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/

You are in

Ready to build

Your lab space stays available for the next two weeks. Use it to explore, practice, and build whatever your imagination can think of. Happy building.
